resources.string: Kaivor uses Accessibility only to run tasks you send from your own Telegram chat — tap, type, and scroll in apps on your phone. Open source. No cloud server. Your screen data stays on this device.

Google blocks APKs opened from Telegram or browsers when they use Accessibility. This is not a Kaivor bug. To install with Play Protect ON: register com.kaivor.agent at Android Developer Console (developer.android.com/developer-verification), upload the release APK, then install from Files — or use Google Play internal testing. See kaivorapp.vercel.app#security
